gloss_en: Sarah (שָׂרָה) — the biblical matriarch, wife of Abraham and mother of Isaac, whose name is expounded (per Rashi/Berakhot 13a, from שׂרר 'to rule') as 'she who rules over the entire world'; the aspect of malchut/sovereignty, homiletically linked to song (shir, 've-sharim ke-cholelim') and to ruling speech (dibbur)
